confirmRemoveDomainGroup: Move all {count} rules in {domain} to Trash?
unsavedScope: No saved rule for this scope
title: Native Dark Mode
rulesNote: Saved locally. Disabled rules remain as exclusions. Specific sections take priority. Queries and fragments are ignored.
importNote: Rules absent from the file are kept. Enabled rules may activate dark mode in matching open tabs.
scopeFamily: Applies to {scope} and its subdomains. A leading www is ignored.
scopeExact: Applies to {scope} on this hostname only.
active: Native dark mode is active in this tab.
inactive: Native dark mode is inactive in this tab.
exportPrepared: Export prepared: {count} rules. Check your browser downloads.
fileValidated: File validated. No settings have changed yet.
importCanceled: Import canceled. No settings were changed.
importSaved: Import saved: {added} added, {updated} updated, {skipped} unchanged. Matching tabs are being updated.
errorJson: The file is not valid JSON.
errorSize: Choose a JSON backup no larger than 1 MiB.
errorLimit: The configuration may contain at most 1,000 rules.
errorRule: Rule {count} is invalid. Check its hostname, path and settings.
errorTimeout: The browser is taking too long. The rule may already be saved. Reopen the popup to check.
errorPage: Open an HTTP or HTTPS page to manage website rules.
errorDetached: Connection ended ({reason}). Automatic activation is paused for this tab. Enable it manually to resume.
scopeSectionRoot: The root path covers the entire site. Enter a path like /blog to limit the rule to a section.
scopeSectionDescendants: Includes this path and its subpaths.
errorScopeConflict: A rule already exists for this scope. Edit it from the saved list.
errorInheritedRuleChanged: The tab no longer inherits a rule. Reopen the popup.
trashDescription: Restore deleted rules or permanently empty the trash.
confirmEmptyTrash: Permanently delete the rules currently shown in the trash? This cannot be undone.
importMode: How should the backup be imported?
importUpdateMatches: Add new rules and update matches
confirmReplaceAll: Replace the entire saved rule list with the rules from this backup?
importRemovalImpact: Current rules absent from the backup will be permanently deleted ({count}).
importKeepImpact: Current rules absent from the backup will be kept.
errorImportPreview: The import preview could not be loaded. Reload the extension and try again.
errorStaleImport: Saved rules changed. Cancel and select the backup again to review the updated preview.
toggleHelp: Changes whether dark mode is enabled for this scope and saves the rule.
saveHelp: Saves this scope and its settings without switching the rule on or off. New rules are saved disabled.
excludeHostHelp: Creates an exception for the current host while keeping the broader rule.
scopeWebsiteHelp: Covers the whole hostname. For example, example.com includes example.com/blog and example.com/shop.
scopeSectionHelp: Covers the selected path. With Include subpaths on, example.com/blog also covers example.com/blog/post.
websitePresetContrastHelp: High contrast emphasizes text and controls.
errorWebsitePreset: The website theme could not be applied to this page.
